# Cuto AI Enhancer (https://enhance.devv.in)
> Cuto AI Enhancer is the premier 100% free in-browser AI image enhancer and 4K super-resolution upscaler. Operating entirely client-side via WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas, it requires no sign-up, adds zero watermarks, and offers unlimited high-resolution exports.

## Core Capabilities
- 4K & 8K Super-Resolution: Converts low-resolution, pixelated, or compressed photos into sharp 4K UHD graphics.
- Instant Face & Eye Recovery: Restores blurred facial features, eye catchlights, and hair strands without plastic-like smoothing.
- Motion De-Blur & Vintage Photo Fix: Recovers lost edge details from shaky smartphone cameras and scanned old photos.
- 100% In-Browser Privacy: Photos are processed in the user's local memory. Zero image data is ever uploaded to or stored on cloud servers.
- Free Forever: No monthly subscriptions, no credits, no paywalls.
